pages.text: Choose $(l)In world$() to place a building with the $(l)Architect's Plans$() instead. A translucent ghost shows where it goes: scroll to rotate it, shift-scroll to raise or lower it, and use the plans to confirm.
$(l)Roads$(): with the plans, click from point to point to lay a road; scroll to change its width and pick a material in the Build page.

$(l)Architect view$(): shift + right-click in the air with the plans, the Architect view button on the Build page, or its key (unbound by default) lifts a free camera over your town. Fly around, pick a building or road from the side panel and click to plan it. Your body stays behind and can be hurt: any damage closes the view.
